name: openclaw-semantic-memory-impl
description: Reference implementation of OpenClaw Semantic Memory (v0.1, Phase-1).

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @osm/core build && pnpm --filter @osm/store build && pnpm --filter @osm/chunker build && pnpm --filter @osm/embed build && pnpm --filter @osm/capture build && pnpm --filter @osm/retrieve build && pnpm --filter @osm/eval build && pnpm --filter @osm/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @osm/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/chunker typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/embed typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/capture typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/retrieve typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/eval typecheck && pnpm --filter @osm/cli typecheck
